verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe LiteLLM's core gateway as a self-hosted proxy with virtual keys, cost tracking and an admin UI, and document a CLI for running it with configurable worker processes. A community user independently confirms running it in a homelab via the litellm/litellm Docker image. missing for 10: in-depth first-party deployment documentation (Docker/Kubernetes install guides) in the evidence, explicit open-source license terms for the core, and clarity on which self-hosted features (e.g. multi-region, admin/worker split) need an enterprise license.
